A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (12 November 2022). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-attackrun-PC-Errata-2022-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Attack Run (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]] (17 August 2019): The game text changes: “'blown away.'” becomes “"blown away."”; “or” becomes “(or”; “is present.” becomes “aboard) just before Pull Up!”; “opponent's” is added after “highest ability of”; “trench. ✶Your” becomes “trench just before Pull Up! ✶Your”. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels, with the mark “D-E1” in the lower border in place of the bronze disc.

The whole 2019 disc card image and the whole 2022 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
